messages:
incident-bot: [SEV2] Elevated 5xx rate and tail latency on embeddings route embeds-prod-us (/v1/embeddings/text-embed-002). 5m error rate ~55%, p95 latency spiking. Paging oncall.

oncall-alex: on it. triaging now — pulling logs and router metrics.

sylvia: looking at routing table — a handful of heavy customers are hitting the embeds hot-route, QPS spike from ent-slice-3. Could be a bad batch job.

raj: if embeds are starving chat, we should consider immediate per-endpoint rebalancing: throttle embeddings global QPS and bump chat route priority. low-friction mitigation: reduce embeds route cap for public route and carve critical enterprise slice.

mike: agreed. preparing a quick cap change. planning steps: 1) reduce /v1/embeddings default route to 30qps; 2) carve ent-slice-3 -> 60qps reserved; 3) disable rerank for free-tier ingesters for next 20m.

lisa: tag me before you apply; I'll notify CS for customers potentially impacted (ent-slice-3 and a few startups).

oncall-alex: executing now. commands: ```
# set default embeddings route cap
redwoodctl quota set route embeds-prod-us --cap=30qps --scope=global
# reserve slice for enterprise
redwoodctl quota set slice ent-slice-3 --route=embeds-prod-us --cap=60qps
# disable rerank on free tier
redwoodctl feature toggle rerank --scope=public --state=off
```

incident-bot: deploybot: quota change job 88122 queued -> success on embeds-prod-us. rerank toggle job 88123 success.

mike: monitoring. error rate dropped to ~18% in 90s, p95 latency trending down. still keeping the enterprise carve to avoid customer impact.

lisa: CS notified oncall: @cs-ops — sent DM to top 5 affected customers explaining temporary perf mitigation, offering priority support and ETA.

cs-ops: confirmed. two customers replied flagged as high severity — we routed them to dedicated engineer.

raj: next steps: keep mitigations for 30m, gather logs and sample prompt sets that hit the heavy path, then revert rerank toggle only if stable. add spike detection rule to alert earlier.

oncall-alex: creating incident page and assigning postmortem owner. assigning sylvia to own RCA.

sylvia: will collect kernel traces, router histograms, and any related batch job logs. suspect a rogue nightly enrich job from one customer.

mike: putting a temporary rule to drop rerank for public embeddings route only; enterprise slices unaffected. command shown above applied.

incident-bot: [UPDATE] mitigations applied. customer-impact: degraded embeddings for public/free tier, enterprise prioritized. severity remains SEV2 -> monitoring for 15m.

oncall-alex: handing off to oncall-night (raj) in 30m. I'll leave notes on ongoing mitigations and contacts. :white_check_mark:

raj: received handoff. will keep watch and coordinate next actions if error rate creeps back up.

sylvia: started data collection. saving logs to /incidents/1758882022/ for postmortem.

mike: closing loop for now — will update thread with reversion plan once stable. :thumbsup:
